# opusdns_zone (Data Source)

Fetches information about an existing DNS zone in OpusDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "zone_dnssec_status" {
  value = data.opusdns_zone.example.dnssec_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name of the DNS zone (e.g., `example.com`).

### Read-Only

- `dnssec_status` (String) The DNSSEC status of the zone (`enabled` or `disabled`).
- `id` (String) The zone name (used as the unique identifier).
